title: Potential Mechanism of Qiju Dihuang Pill in Treating Primary Sjogren's Syndrome Revealed by Network Pharmacology and Experimental Verification.
authors: Wang, Huiying; Cheng, Hui; Li, Mei; Zhu, Xiaofang; Wang, Xiaobing
one_liner_zh: 该文通过网络药理学和分子对接研究中药复方治疗干燥综合征的机制，虽含分子对接但对象为药物-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Primary Sjogren's syndrome (pSS) presents as a persistent inflammatory condition marked by a spectrum of symptoms and a limited array of conventional therapeutic interventions. Within Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM), the Qiju Dihuang Pill (QJDHW) stands as a frequently employed prescription for addressing this syndrome, yet the underlying therapeutic mechanisms remain elusive. Traditional Chinese Medicine Systems Pharmacology (TCMSP) and three disease gene databases, DisGnet, GeneCards, and OMIM, were utilized to establish QJDHW targets and pSS-related gene sets. Cytoscape was used to construct Protein-protein interaction (PPI) and active compound-target networks, followed by Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) enrichment via the DAVID database. Molecular docking was conducted with AutoDock Vina, and in vitro experiments verified the key findings. A total of 62 overlapping targets were identified. Network analysis revealed quercetin and kaempferol as major active compounds. KEGG enrichment indicated that QJDHW may exert its therapeutic effects by modulating the immune-inflammatory response. Four key targets, namely NFKBIA, IL-6, JUN, and IL-1B, were identified as the central mediators. Molecular docking analysis confirmed their binding affinity with the major active compounds. In vitro assays further confirmed that quercetin and kaempferol suppressed the mRNA expression of key inflammation-related factors, including IL-6, IL-1B, JUN, and NFKB, while reducing IL-6 and IL-1B protein levels and significantly inhibiting the phosphorylation of JUN and NFKB. Collectively, the integration of network pharmacology and experimental validation demonstrated that QJDHW exerts anti-inflammatory effects in treating pSS.
abstract_zh: 原发性干燥综合征（pSS）表现为一种持续性炎症状态，特征为一系列症状及有限的常规治疗手段。在中医（TCM）中，杞菊地黄丸（QJDHW）是治疗该综合征的常用方剂，但其潜在治疗机制尚不明确。利用中药系统药理学数据库与分析平台（TCMSP）及三个疾病基因数据库DisGnet、GeneCards和OMIM，建立了QJDHW靶点及pSS相关基因集。使用Cytoscape构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络及活性化合物-靶点网络，随后通过DAVID数据库进行京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）富集分析。分子对接采用AutoDock Vina进行，并通过体外实验验证关键发现。共识别出62个重叠靶点。网络分析显示槲皮素和山柰酚为主要活性化合物。KEGG富集表明，QJDHW可能通过调节免疫炎症反应发挥其治疗作用。四个关键靶点，即NFKBIA、IL-6、JUN和IL-1B，被确定为核心介质。分子对接分析确认了它们与主要活性化合物的结合亲和力。体外实验进一步证实，槲皮素和山柰酚抑制了关键炎症相关因子（包括IL-6、IL-1B、JUN和NFKB）的mRNA表达，同时降低IL-6和IL-1B蛋白水平，并显著抑制JUN和NFKB的磷酸化。综上，网络药理学与实验验证的整合表明，QJDHW在治疗pSS中发挥抗炎作用。
